<script language="JavaScript">

	
function chk_crsno_desc(syr,sm,crsno,item_no) {
	//alert(syr);
	//if ((syr!='')){	
	if ((syr!='')&&(sm!='')&&(crsno!='')&&(item_no!='')){	
			//alert('1111');
				$.ajax({
						type: 	"get",
						url: 	"chk_crsno_desc.asp",
						data:	{	
									ACTION:	"1",
									SYEAR: syr,			     								
									SEM: sm,			     								
									CRSNO: crsno
								},     			
						contentType: "application/text; charset=utf-8",
						dataType:	"json",
						async: false,
						success:function(json){
							//alert("成功~");
							
							var data = json.data;
							//alert("成功~data.length="+data.length);
							if(data == null || data.length < 1){
								//alert("parameters:SYEAR="+$('input[name=QM_SYEAR]').val()+"&SEM="+$('input[name=QM_SEM]').val()+"&CRS_DESC="+$('input[name=CRS_DESC]').val()+"&DPT_COD="+$('#DPT_COD_ID').val()+"&GRADE="+$('#GRADE_ID').val()+"&CLASS_COD="+$('#CLASS_COD_ID').val()+"&SECT_COD="+$('input[name=SECT_COD]').val())
								//	NewWin=window.open("crs_open.asp?ACTION=922&SYEAR="+$('input[name=QM_SYEAR]').val()+"&SEM="+$('input[name=QM_SEM]').val()+"&CRS_DESC="+$('input[name=CRS_DESC]').val()+"&DPT_COD="+$('#DPT_COD_ID').val()+"&GRADE="+$('#GRADE_ID').val()+"&CLASS_COD="+$('#CLASS_COD_ID').val()+"&SECT_COD="+$('input[name=SECT_COD]').val()+'&tm='+new Date(),"DisplayWindow3","toolbar=no,directories=no,menubar=no,width=300pixels,height=200pixels,left=0,top=50");
								$("#CDESC"+item_no).text('找不到課程(Cannot find courses)');	
							}else if(data.length == 1){
									
									
									//$("#pick_crs_cod_body tr").remove();
									
									$.each(data, function(i, n){
										
											$("#CDESC"+item_no).text(n.CRS_DESC+'['+n.T_NAME+']');
										
										
									});	// end each
									//	$( "#pick_crs_cod_dialog" ).dialog( "open" );	
							
							}	// end if
							
						},
						error:function(xhr, ajaxOptions, thrownError){
						alert(xhr.status+":"+xhr.statusText);
					}
				});
		}
}	


function MakeArray(n){ //字串陣列
  this.length = n;
  for(var I=1;I<=n;I++){
    this[I]=0
  }
  return this
}
var totalcourse
totalcourse=0;
Course= new MakeArray (50); //選課單上的課號
Weight= new MakeArray (50); //選課單上的點數
Stage=  new MakeArray (50); //選課單上的階段別

D= new MakeArray (15);
C= new MakeArray (15);
T= new MakeArray (15);
function  Validator()
{
  var i
  var CC,DD,TT
  getdata();
  //alert('here2');
  for (i=1;i<15;i++)
  {
      DD="";
      CC="";
      TT="";
      DD=D[i];  //--動作
      CC=C[i];  //--課號
      TT=T[i];  //--點數
      pass=true;
      if (CC.length>0)
      {
         
            if (DD=="N")
            {
               alert("欄位"+i+"：未選擇加退選動作！\n"+"Field "+i+" not checked !");
               pass=false
               break;
            }
            else
            {
               if(DD=="+")
               { //做加選檢查
               
                  if ((TT > 20) || (TT < 0) || (TT.length<1) )
                  {
                      alert("欄位"+i+"：點數填寫錯誤應填入[0~20]\n"+"Field "+i+" wrong number,it should be [0~20]");
                      pass=false;
                      break;
                  }
                  else
                  {
                       //傳回false 表一般課程課號全為數字
                          
                             
                                 if (checkpoint(TT,0))
                                 { //檢查點數欄是否正確
                                    if(dup_courseno(CC))
                                    {//課號重複
                                        pass=false;
                                        alert("欄位"+i+"：一般課程加選課號重複，請重新輸入\n"+"Field "+i+" duplicated course code");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (TT>20 || TT<0)
                                        {
                                            alert("欄位"+i+"：志願不合法，志願填寫錯誤應填入[1~20]\n"+"Field "+i+" wrong priority number, it should be [1~20]");
                                            pass=false; //不合法的英文起始課號
                                            break;                                                                          
                                        } 
                                        else
                                        { 
                                            pass=true;
                                        }
                                    }
                                 }//end of if (checkpoint(TT,0)) 檢查點數欄是否正確
                                 else
                                 {
                                    alert("欄位"+i+"：志願不合法，志願填寫錯誤應填入[1~20]\n"+"Field "+i+" wrong priority number, it should be [1~20]");
                                    pass=false; //不合法的英文起始課號
                                    break;
                                 }                          
                             
                          
                          
                          
                      
                      
                  }
               }
               else
               {//做退選檢查
                  pass1=true;
                  for(var j=1;j<=totalcourse;j++)
                  {
                     if (CC.toUpperCase()==Course[j])
                     {
                        pass1=true
                        pass=true
                        break;
                     }
                     else
                     {
                        pass1=false
                        pass=false;
                     }
                  }
                  if(pass1)
                  {
                     pass=true;
                  }
                  else{
                     alert("欄位"+i+"：退選課號不存在，請重新輸入\n"+"Field "+i+" wrong course code");
                     pass=false;
                     break;
                  }
               }//end of 做退選檢查
            }   
         
      }
  }
  //alert('here');
  //20161005 eddieliu, cancel the confirm
  //if (pass){
  //  if (document.f1.step.value=='2'){
    	 
  //         fg=confirm("Did you double check whether the information is correct?");
       
  //         fg=confirm("資料送出後就不可再更改了是否確定要送出?");
       
  //         if (fg)
  //            return (true);
  //         else
  //           return (false);    
  //   }         
  //}else{
     return pass
  // }  
}
function dup_courseno(item)
{
  
  for(var j=1;j<totalcourse+1;j++)
  {
      if (item.toUpperCase()==Course[j])
      {
          return true
      }
      else
      {
          if (j==totalcourse)
          {
            return false
          }   
      }
  }
  return false
}

function  Is_interest(crsno)
{//檢查是否892初選第二階段可加選的英文字母開頭課號
 var Ucrsno
 var F2Ucrsno
 Ucrsno=crsno.toUpperCase();
 if (Ucrsno.length==8)
 {
       F2Ucrsno=Ucrsno.substring(0,2);
       if ((F2Ucrsno=="AC")||(F2Ucrsno=="AD")||(F2Ucrsno=="AE")||(F2Ucrsno=="AS")||(F2Ucrsno=="AB")||(F2Ucrsno=="AG")||(F2Ucrsno=="AI")||(F2Ucrsno=="AH"))
       {
           if(checkpoint(Ucrsno,5))
           {
              return true
           }
           else
           {    
              return false
           }
       }
 }
 else
 {  
   return false
 }
}

function checkpoint(str,k) //檢查str 自第k個位置之後是否全為數字
{
 checkStr = str;
 checkOK = "0123456789"
 allValid = true;
 if( checkStr.substring(0,1)=="0" && checkStr.length>1)
 {
    allValid = false
 }
 else
 {
   for (i = k;  i < checkStr.length;  i++){
      ch = checkStr.charAt(i);
      for (j = 0;  j < checkOK.length;  j++)
           if (ch == checkOK.charAt(j))
               break;
           if (j == checkOK.length){
               allValid = false;
               break;
           }
   }
 }
 return (allValid);
}
